title: Number of Burgers with No Waste of Ingredients
summary: Given the quantities of tomato slices and cheese slices, determine the number of jumbo and small burgers that can be made such that all ingredients are used up.
statement: Given the quantities of tomato slices and cheese slices, determine the number of jumbo and small burgers that can be made such that all ingredients are used up. If it's impossible, return an empty list.
constraints: Jumbo burgers use four tomato slices; small burgers use two; both use one cheese slice.
hints: Subtract twice the cheese equation to get 2j=tomato-2*cheese.
Compute both counts and validate nonnegativity and exact consumption.
The linear system has at most one integer solution.
editorial: The linear system has at most one integer solution.

tests.explanation: Solving the two equations gives one jumbo and six small burgers.
An odd tomato count cannot be consumed exactly.
